title: feat(index): use widget [PART-2]
body:
This PR introduces the usage of the `index` widget through `InstantSearch`. With the previous PR, we saw that the widget is now responsible for managing widgets & state. We now leverage the widget inside `InstantSearch`.

By default, all `InstantSearch` instance has a "main" index that replaces the logic that was previously inside the instance. The instance exposes functions (like `scheduleXXX`) to be able to manage multiple indices at the same time. The `index` widgets are self-contained and they don't have that much knowledge about the external world. The instance is here to "sync" their behavior (like a `render`). The change should be invisible for regular users since the API didn't change.

With these changes, I've merged all the tests related to `InstantSearch` inside the same module. I also get rid of a bunch of them because we cover most of them through the `index` widget. Inside the PR I've tried to linked which test is replacing what to ease the review.
